init_edge_rot_euler_angles: compute Euler angles (alpha, beta, gamma) from a normalized 3D edge distance vector tensor
wigner_D: compute the Wigner D-matrix for a given angular momentum level using three Euler angles and precomputed J matrices
eulers_to_wigner: convert Euler angle tensors into a block-diagonal Wigner D-matrix spanning a range of lmax values
Safeacos: apply a numerically stable arccos operation with safe gradient clipping for use in PyTorch autograd graphs
Safeatan2: apply a numerically stable atan2 operation with safe gradient clipping for use in PyTorch autograd graphs
